seed: Express the mechanics as pairwise interactions between types with named guards, such as blocking, pushing, collecting or toggling, and derive single-type rules from them.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 moves 5 cells (A1-4); dest box with wall colour 4 / void 5 / off-board is blocked but still costs.
Colour-1 edge strip on the dest cell is a conveyor: player slides away from it until blocked.
Each action burns the leftmost 2 bar cells (11->3, rows 61-62); covering a refuel ring consumes it and refills the bar.
Covering a collect target rotates the 3x3 HUD glyph CW; under-player cells remembered (continuity-gated) and restored.
Unconfirmed: chamber entry while glyph != legend is a free no-op; unlock condition and A5-A7 unobserved.
